title: Palindrome
required_features: A synthesis-safe polymorphic equality component that can be instantiated for arbitrary elements and List a values without an unconstrained-shape failure during component search.
Equivalently, a trusted exact finite-list equality primitive with a verified OCaml (=) lowering, available to the Boolean goal but not spuriously applied while synthesizing list-valued helpers.
semantic_obligations: For every finite input list xs, is_palindrome xs returns true if and only if xs equals reverse(xs) as an exact sequence.
The relation preserves element order and multiplicity; equal sets, equal lengths, or an always-true answer are insufficient.
The only public entry point is polymorphic: 'a list -> bool.
No mutation, effects, randomness, option result, exception protocol, index convention, or infinite/coinductive-stream behavior is introduced by the exercise.
Element comparison follows ordinary OCaml polymorphic structural equality after lowering; this inherits OCaml's functional-value and NaN caveats.
